findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1 rather than 0, so existing callers that did not pass `min` now get a different wait floor.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, jitter=0)` or any config where the computed wait is below 1 second. Previously the wait was `max(0, min(result, max))`; now it is clamped up to 1 second. Retries that waited 0.1s now wait 1s, a silent behavior change and a backward-incompatible default.
